Independent Windows overlay for AION2 schedules, notifications and TCP latency.

- Optional startup auto-update with download progress, checksums, backup and rollback.
- Six dark themes, pictograms, local boss portraits and countdown gauges.
- Alert switches, sound previews and notification lead controls.
- Server load bars, 24-hour history, faction/pair balance and Steam history charts.
- Public JSON only: automatic quarter-hour refresh; manual refresh starts a new 15-minute cadence for this session.
- Existing event schedules, Shugo notifications, settings, checks and simple Ping remain supported.

Download the versioned ZIP below and extract it to a new folder. Run `AION2_Event_Overlay_Ping.exe` (no Python required). To migrate manually, close the old app and copy its `data` folder into the new folder. Public releases never include personal settings. Earlier releases and downloads are retained.

This app does not modify the game client or read game memory/packets. Times are estimates based on saved schedules; reset boss anchors after maintenance. See README and CHANGES for details and verification limits. Game portraits remain NCSOFT property; see `assets/THIRD_PARTY.md`.
